correctness.rationale: Every factor of even length is exactly E(u) or O(u) by parity of its starting position. For input lengths >=2 the images are disjoint because overlap would require a forbidden all-ones input; base F_2={00,01,10}, so |F_{2^j}|=3·2^{j-1}. The endpoint-zero-count matrices have only two zero-content strata and evolve exactly as (z,a,b)->(2m-z,2b,a+b), swapping strata. The parity table follows by induction with 2^j mod6. At the next scale the three disjoint 2-Abelian signature types per stratum have exact cardinalities (a+b,a+b,2b). Substitution yields the stated six sizes for all k>=3, including nonempty class and boundary cases. Replayed exact checker directly enumerates factors through k=10 and separately checks E/O recursion and signature profiles; finite tests corroborate the induction only.

value.rationale: The six class sizes quantify ambiguity in reconstructing a distinct period-doubling factor from local single-letter and digram counts, rather than merely giving the previously studied number of signatures. The result simultaneously gives exact all-dyadic multiplicities, a proof-driven endpoint census, and sharp linear extrema (~N/6 and ~N/3); these cannot be inferred from class-count complexity alone. It is a natural complete classification for a canonical automatic word and a motivated invariant, not a single small computation.
